Detailed Description

Buffered terminal frame rendering.

Accumulates terminal output (ANSI codes, text, colors) into a single buffer, then flushes the entire frame in one atomic write. This eliminates the flicker that occurs when clearing the screen and rendering line-by-line.

Usage pattern: frame_buffer_t *buf = frame_buffer_create(rows, cols); frame_buffer_clear_screen(buf); frame_buffer_printf(buf, "Header line 1\n"); frame_buffer_printf(buf, "Header line 2\n"); frame_buffer_flush(buf); // Later, reuse the buffer: frame_buffer_reset(buf); frame_buffer_printf(buf, "New content\n"); frame_buffer_flush(buf);
